resources.string: Enter your Navidrome server and credentials. The connection is verified before saving. On a phone, use the computer’s LAN/Tailscale address, not localhost.
Allow HTTP on a local network or VPN
HTTP does not encrypt the connection: use only on a trusted local network or active VPN. WalkTape does not enable Tailscale.
Remove %1$s? Credentials and local data, including any downloads (%2$d bytes), will be deleted. The server will not be changed.
Check URL, required fields and profile name (unique, up to 80 characters). HTTP requires local/VPN consent.
Protected credentials unavailable. Remove and configure the profile again.
Unable to remove local data. Try again.
Server unreachable. Check the address, network and VPN, then retry.
The server did not respond in time. Retry.
Invalid HTTPS certificate or failed TLS connection.
The response is not a valid OpenSubsonic response.
HTTP error. Check the server and any proxy.
The server does not support token+salt authentication.
Unable to generate the QR code.
Profile connected. Library indexing will be implemented in the next development phase.
The QR contains the URL, profile name and username. The password is not included: enter it on the scanning device.
